title: Important Notice on System Migration Affecting Binance Convert Recurring Plans
text: This is a general announcement. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region. Note : This announcement was updated on 2025-12-24 to clarify that the system migration maintenance period is from  2026-01-06 02:00 (UTC) to 2026-01-06 10:00 (UTC) . Fellow Binancians, To better enhance your trading experience with Binance Convert Recurring, we will perform a scheduled system migration from  2026-01-06 02:00 (UTC) to 2026-01-06 10:00 (UTC) .  Please take note of the important impact on your plan(s) below: During this system migration maintenance window: New subscriptions for Convert Recurring Plans will be paused. Existing plans with transaction times scheduled between  02:00 and 10:00 (UTC) on 2026-01-06  might  not  be executed. We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience this upgrade may cause and greatly appreciate your patience. Regular service for all Binance Convert Recurring Plans will resume immediately after the migration is complete. Thank you for your continued support. Should you have any queries, please reach out to our  Customer Support Team  for assistance.  Note : There may be discrepancies between this original content in English and any translated versions. Please refer to the original English version for the most accurate information, in case any discrepancies arise. Thank you for your support! Binance Team 2025-12-23
